featured_techniques.technique: Framing the talk around brand storytelling and marketplace perception (opening question about your story)
Self-reflection prompt: use of a 'challenge question' to assess current position

sections.description: Opening questions about the story being told about you in the marketplace by customers and employees; framing the talk as a journey studying great companies that become beloved; introduction of a 'challenge question' to encourage self-evaluation of current positioning.
sections.title: Opening framing: your brand story and the challenge

summary: Jeanne Bliss asks viewers to consider the narrative their brand presents to customers and employees, framing the short talk as a study of how great companies earn the right to be seen as beloved. She introduces a self-reflection element—a “challenge question” meant to prompt viewers to evaluate where they stand in shaping that story today and how they might respond to the ongoing challenges in marketplace storytelling.
title: What Story Is Being Told About You In the Marketplace? — Self-Reflection on Brand Narrative
